Similarity classes are deterministic screening labels, not proof of variant identity or biological effect. Heuristic windows are used only when VCF breakpoint confidence intervals are unavailable. BND records with a parsed mate are compared using both breakends and the chromosome pair, allowing reversed record order. Input orientation is retained but cannot be compared because it is absent from this gnomAD response. BND records without a mate retain first-breakend-only candidate matching. Adaptive retrieval padding, when nonzero, widens only the records retrieved from the API; it never widens the fixed matching windows. A gnomAD-SV absence does not establish novelty, pathogenicity, or technical validity.
